description: A second ordinary request starts without cancelling an independent earlier routed turn; only an explicit protective control or Core-authorized interruption may cancel prior work.

input.text: One person asks for a check, then another person makes an independent request while the first is still running.

memberships.title: Evidence Coverage And Claim Discipline
memberships.general_rule: Tests should prove the user-visible boundary being claimed and should retain enough trace detail to locate the earliest wrong component.
memberships.rationale: Overlapping ordinary turns preserve each independent outcome.

memberships.title: Evidence-Bound Cognitive Turn Closure
memberships.general_rule: Every admitted turn should preserve its identity and independent work across overlapping ordinary requests; only explicit protective control or Core-authorized interruption may cancel it. Effectful turns retain completed, missing, failed, and cancelled outcomes, commit goal state, suppress stale speech, and emit at most one evidence-bound speech-only final while the turn remains current.
memberships.rationale: An independent ordinary request must not implicitly cancel an earlier in-flight turn; cancellation remains explicit and attributable.

memberships.title: Human-like Cognitive Continuity
memberships.general_rule: Chromie should remain one continuous interlocutor while work progresses: preserve recent meaning, avoid duplicate acknowledgements, keep conversation available, and let follow-up turns revise only the relevant unfinished responsibility.
memberships.rationale: A newer conversational turn does not erase valid unfinished work from the prior turn.
